lines.text: Jesus tells the Pharisees the kingdom of God will not come with observable signs, for it is in their midst.
Jesus tells the disciples not to chase reports of the Son of Man, who will come like lightning across the sky.
In the days of Noah, people were eating and drinking and marrying until Noah entered the ark, and then the flood came.
On the day Lot left Sodom, hail and darkness rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
On that day, no one on the housetop should come down for his possessions, and Jesus says to remember Abraham's wife.
